label: FishBase LENGTH-WEIGHT table (length–weight relationship parameters a, b per species)
bibliographic_citation: Froese R, Pauly D (eds) FishBase. World Wide Web electronic publication, www.fishbase.org.

distributions.description: table documentation (HTTP 200 on retrieval); the data table itself is reached per species via the web interface and was not downloaded

measurement_technique: Compiled published length–weight regressions W = a·L^b per species and population.
role: length–weight exponent b (Thompson's W = kL^3) for fishes; the direct test data for claim thompson1917-ch02-01
notes: Recorded as a pointer only: FishBase has no open bulk download endpoint reachable here, so no file was inspected and no counts are recorded.
